opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding quality teaching; institutions may make one application per round; individual scholars or students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for arts training for school‑age children under 18, covering tuition, maintenance, equipment, travel and audition costs, to support outstanding students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Bursaries of £5,000 to £10,000 per student per year; maximum total award of £475,000 per institution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that offer undergraduate or postgraduate taught arts courses; institutions may make one application per round; individual scholars or students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support undergraduate and postgraduate arts students in financial need, covering maintenance, fees or other costs.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year 1 and up to £28,000 in years 2‑3 (salary contribution); up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate and have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date; must be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, providing salary contribution and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers who hold or have held a UK university post with research degree‑awarding powers; must be resident in the UK for at least 26 weeks of the year.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for retired researchers to complete or integrate a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Up to £5 million total (ten awards) for up to 30 doctoral scholarships; additional funding for under‑represented groups, post‑doctoral opportunities and programme administration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply; scholarships are awarded to individual students, not directly to applicants.
opportunities.summary: Provides substantial funding to UK universities to establish doctoral scholarships (and related post‑doctoral and cohort‑building activities) in interdisciplinary priority areas.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with the Office for Students and holding research degree‑awarding powers) may apply as principal applicant; collaborative centres encouraged; one application per university as principal.
opportunities.summary: Supports the establishment of large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship, with flexible topics and the possibility of multi‑institution collaboration.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (up to £56,000 in year 1, up to £28,000 in years 2‑3) plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established, distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers; must not have held a Major Research Fellowship before.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for two‑ or three‑year fellowships to enable senior researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at an early stage of their career (doctoral award ≤10 years before closing date) holding a permanent post or long‑term fellowship at a UK university; must not be nominated for more than one prize subject in a 3‑year cycle.
opportunities.summary: Awards to early‑career researchers of international impact, usable for any research purpose within the Trust’s eligible categories.
discipline_tags: Broad range of 18 subject areas (excluding medical/clinical research)

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications

amount.raw: Maximum grant value £500,000; up to 25 % of budget for associated research costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (or eligible UK independent research institutes on a trial basis); principal investigators must be employed by the institution; must not fall within excluded research areas.
opportunities.summary: Supports innovative and original research projects up to five years, providing staff costs and associated research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will host an eminent senior professor from overseas; host institution must approve and administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of eminent overseas scholars to UK institutions to enhance skills and knowledge, with a minimum three‑month duration.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for up to 5 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career UK university academics (lecturer level or equivalent) with ≤2 years post‑PhD experience; must not have led a research team or held comparable large‑scale awards.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and delivering transformative research.
